versions.content: The associated RTE Implementation Plug-In shall pro- vide the Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF 878 of 1476 Document ID 84: AUTOSAR_SWS_RTE Specification of RTE Software AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has its Ld- ComApiType parameter set to LDCOM_IF [SWS_LDCOM_00054].

The associated Local Software Cluster Communica- tion Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_NotifyTxConfirmation Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references an LdComApiType which has its Ld- ComApiType parameter set to LDCOM_IF [SWS_LDCOM_00054].

Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00300, SRS_Rte_00301, SRS_Rte_00312, SRS_Rte_00317 The associated Local Software Cluster Communication Plug-In shall provide the Rte_Rips_<PlugIn>_NotifyTxConfirmation_<CGI> Service for each • dataElement instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component • operation instance in a PortPrototype of an Atomic Software Compo- nent • trigger instance in an AbstractProvidedPortPrototype of an Atomic Software Component IF • for the related Communication Graph the RTE Implementation Plug-In support is enabled AND • a transformation is configured according to [SWS_Rte_08794]. AND • the Communication Graph references a ComIPdu which has its ComIPdu- Type parameter set to NORMAL [SWS_COM_00916].
